caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic pitcher with a hammered texture, rendered in various shades of brown and copper colors. The pitcher features a relatively tall, cylindrical upper body that tapers slightly towards the top, and the rim appears uneven and wavy. Attached to the right side of the vessel is a curved handle affixed near the rim and extending downward. The main body of the pitcher transitions into a rounded, bulbous lower section that narrows toward a short, circular base. The hammered texture covers the entire surface and is visible through a pattern of small, irregular indentations. The pitcher is centrally positioned against a plain, off-white background with no additional objects or decorative elements. In small print near the bottom right of the pitcher, the name "Edward T. Jewett" is visible.
title: Copper Cruet
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
